Welcome to EECS
The Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS) at Texas A&M University-Kingsville provides broad-based programs leading to B.S. and M.S. degrees in electrical engineering, computer science, and computer engineering. .
Message from the Chair
Welcome to the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS) at the Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering at Texas A&M University-Kingsville! As the new Chair of this dynamic department, I am honored to welcome you and introduce our department and programs.

The Computer Science Program Educational Objectives are:
Our graduates will establish themselves as professionals or engage in advanced study in Computer Science and related fields.
Our graduates will demonstrate lifelong learning skills and adaptability to ever-changing technological environments; through continuous learning, they will become well-rounded, contributing members of society.
Our graduates will have a positive impact on society responsibly, professionally, and ethically.
